# House of Chirmi

> House of Chirmi is a Shopify design and development studio based in India (it also builds custom-coded websites). It designs, builds and grows Shopify stores for independent brands of all kinds — fashion, jewellery, bags and accessories, home décor, handloom — and offers monthly brand partnerships. Not to be confused with "Home of Chirmi", a separate Jaipur furniture brand.

- Website: https://www.houseofchirmi.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/houseofchirmi/ (main) and https://www.instagram.com/houseofchirmi.studio/ (websites)
- Contact: houseofchirmi@gmail.com

## Services
- [Shopify storefronts](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/studio): Launch ₹35,000 (10 days), Growth ₹65,000 (3 weeks), Signature ₹1,10,000
- [Custom-coded websites](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/studio): quoted per project
- [Brand partnership](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/brands): monthly, from ₹22,000

## Work (Shopify stores)
- [Rawish Designs](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/rawish-designs) — Kashmiri craft fashion
- [Cannish Pitara](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/cannish-pitara) — handmade vegan bags
- [Lakhmanis](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/lakhmanis) — womenswear
- [Soven Home](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/soven-home) — home décor
- [Dumroo](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/dumroo) — jewellery
